name: v0.30.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(ci/docker): pin taskdog version in Docker images and build them in CI by @aloneangel45 in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1284
* chore(deps): bump ruff from 0.17.3 to 0.17.4 in the dev-dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1286
* chore(deps): bump types-python-dateutil from 2.9.0.20261029 to 2.9.0.20261104 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1288
* chore(deps): bump pytest-asyncio from 1.4.1 to 1.4.1.post1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1289
* chore(deps): bump opentelemetry-api from 1.45.1 to 1.45.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1291
* chore(deps): bump the dev-dependencies group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1292
* chore(deps): bump the production-dependencies group across 1 directory with 7 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1293
* chore: pre-commit autoupdate by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1285
* feat(server/client/mcp): atomic append_task_note to prevent lost note-log updates by @officialasishkumar in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1294
* chore(deps): bump ruff from 0.17.5 to 0.17.6 in the dev-dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1297
* chore(deps): bump the production-dependencies group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1298
* chore(deps): bump types-python-dateutil from 2.9.0.20261104 to 2.9.0.20261116 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1300
* fix(tui): guard gantt cache updates with generation IDs by @lyn1dev in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1302
* fix(core/server): enforce MAX_NOTES_LENGTH on the total note size when appending by @mccalpink in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1301
* chore: pre-commit autoupdate by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1296

## New Contributors
* @aloneangel45 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1284
* @officialasishkumar made their first contribution in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1294
* @lyn1dev made their first contribution in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1302
* @mccalpink made their first contribution in https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/pull/1301

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog/compare/v0.29.1...v0.30.0
